{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:TIE_Bomber_Squadron_2017_Quarter_3_Tournament_Kit.png|thumb|right|240px|A TIE bomber squadron assaulting a pair of Mon Calamari cruisers.]]
'''Bombers''' (occasionally called '''Starbombers''') were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] specifically designed for use against well [[Armor/Legends|armored]], often large or immobile targets, such as [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], and buildings.

==Characteristics==
There were comparatively few types of starfighter found in a pure bombing role, since many less specialized fighters were versatile enough to attack both other fighters and larger or more heavily armored targets.

Most bombers employed some type of projectile weapon, such as [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]], [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], or [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] to attack their targets, rather than energy weapons such as [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. For best effectiveness against defended targets, bombers were escorted by other, nimbler starfighters. For protection against point-defense vessels such as anti-fighter [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], they were sometimes accompanied by support [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] such as [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] which provided cover as they closed on their objectives.

Dedicated bombers include:

*[[Trade Federation droid bomber|Advanced droid bomber]]
*[[E-STAP Droid Starbomber|E-STAP Advanced Droid Starbomber]]
*[[E-STAP Droid Starbomber]]
*[[E-STAP Droid Starbomber|E-STAP Shielded Droid Starbomber]]
*[[Hetrinar assault bomber]]
*[[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class droid bomber]]
*[[NB-1 Royal Bomber]]
*[[NB-1S Royal Bomber]]
*[[NB-1T Royal Bomber]]
*[[NTB-630 naval bomber/Legends|NTB-630 naval bomber]]
*[[Neutralizer-class bomber]]
*[[PTB-625 planetary bomber/Legends|PTB-625 planetary bomber]]
*[[Scythe-class bomber|''Scythe''-class bomber]]
*[[TIE/ca Punisher/Legends|TIE/IT Interdictor starfighter]]
*[[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]]
*[[TIE Heavy Bomber|TIE Heavy bomber]]
*[[Scimitar assault bomber]]
*[[YT-5100 Shriek-class bomber|YT-5100 ''Shriek''-class bomber]]

In addition, some heavy assault starfighters such as [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]], [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter|K-wings]] and [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]]s were occasionally referred to as bombers.
